BoardingPal Terms & Conditions

Version 2.0 · Effective October 22, 2026

1. Acceptance of Terms

These Terms govern your use of BoardingPal, operated by Cosner Pagaddut. By creating an account you agree to these Terms and acknowledge the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not create an account. You may browse published listings without an account.

2. What BoardingPal Is

BoardingPal helps students find boarding houses and helps property owners publish listings and manage reservation requests. BoardingPal is a technology platform only. It is not a landlord, broker, property inspector or guarantor, does not handle payments, and is not a party to any agreement between students and owners. A reservation in BoardingPal is a request and record of interest, not a lease.

3. Eligibility and Accounts

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. Provide accurate information, keep your password secret, and tell us at pagaddutcosner10@gmail.com if you believe your account has been misused. Each account is for one person.

4. Students

Send requests only for rooms you genuinely intend to rent, cancel requests you no longer need, and verify every property in person before paying any deposit or signing any agreement.

5. Property Owners

You may list only properties you own or are authorised to rent out. Listings, rooms, rates, photos and availability must be accurate and kept up to date. Listings are reviewed by our moderators before they go live, and edits to the description, location, rules, amenities or photos of a live listing are reviewed again before they reappear. You must respond honestly to requests and comply with all laws that apply to renting accommodation, including anti-discrimination rules.

6. Content Rules

Do not post or send content that is false or misleading, fraudulent, hateful, harassing, sexually explicit, violent, discriminatory, or that infringes anyone's rights or privacy. Do not post other people's personal information. Photos must show the actual property. You keep ownership of content you post and allow us to host and display it in BoardingPal for the purpose of providing the service.

7. Reporting, Blocking and Moderation

You can report listings and users from within the app and block users you do not want to deal with. We may review, hide, reject or remove content, and suspend accounts, that break these Terms or put others at risk. If an account is suspended, its listings are hidden and its open reservations may be put on hold while we review the situation; we will notify the people affected.

8. Deleting Your Account

You can delete your account at any time in the app (Profile, Settings & privacy, Delete account) or at https://kidungonkeil20-rgb.github.io/boardingpal/delete-account.html. What is deleted and what is kept is explained in the Privacy Policy.

9. Disclaimers and Liability

BoardingPal is provided as is. We do not guarantee the accuracy of listings, the conduct of users, or the availability of the service. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for losses arising from agreements or disputes between students and owners.

10. Changes and Contact

We will ask you to accept updated Terms in the app before you continue using your account. Questions: pagaddutcosner10@gmail.com, Cosner Pagaddut, Lagawe, Ifugao, Philippines.
